resources.string: See the SMS and OTPs from all your phones in one place. Messages are encrypted on the phone that receives them, and only your own phones can read them.
Already set up on another phone?
On that phone, tap the QR icon at the top, then scan the code from here.
That isn\'t a Saral SMS Sync pairing code.
The scanner couldn\'t start. Copy the pairing code on the other phone and paste it here instead.
Off. SMS on this phone stay on this phone.
On. New SMS go to your other phones.
Paused: this needs SMS access and notifications.
Off. Messages wait a few hours for you to turn this on.

Forwarding needs SMS access and notifications, so it always shows on this phone. Open app settings and allow both. If SMS is greyed out, use the ⋮ menu there and tap \"Allow restricted settings\" first.
To be sure a code arrives while this phone is idle, let this app run without battery restrictions.
No messages yet. Use \"Send a test message\" in the ⋮ menu to check your phones are connected.
This SMS was too long to send in full. The rest is on the original phone.
Reached this phone %1$s after the SMS arrived.

Every SMS this phone receives from now on, including bank messages and OTPs, will be encrypted here and sent over the internet to the phones in your group. A public relay passes it on but can\'t read it. Anyone holding one of those phones can read it.\n\nOnly turn this on for your own phone. A notification stays on this phone for as long as it\'s on.
On the other phone, open Saral SMS Sync and scan this code.
Anyone who gets this code can read this group\'s messages. Don\'t share it or take a photo of it.
Test message from Saral SMS Sync. Your phones are connected.
This deletes the messages shown on this phone. Your other phones keep theirs, and the original SMS aren\'t touched.
This phone stops sending and showing messages, and its copies are deleted. To remove a lost phone from the group, leave on every phone and start a new group.
Sending this phone\'s SMS to your other phones
Showing SMS from your other phones
Sending this phone\'s SMS and showing SMS from your other phones
